title: Gateway border-ingress consumes in-transit RH3 datagrams (survey bypass)
description: Security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-xyix: ingest_border_frame (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:121-123) returns non-RPL IPv6 to the gateway with no survey_routing_headers call; dispatch_runtime_gcp (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1291-1300,1343) then feeds it to secure_datagram/secure_transport, which can decrypt and locally execute an RH3-bearing datagram the C router would relay (router.c:505-522), or write it unadvanced to the TUN (lichend.rs:947-951). Requires installed GCP peer context and valid OSCORE. Fix: run survey_routing_headers on gateway-ingress datagrams and drop/relay per RFC 6554 forwarding precedence before GCP dispatch.
